minecraft:held_light_out.name: Snuffed Handheld Light
minecraft:held_light_out.description: Snuffs a stack of torches or lanterns in one hand.

minecraft:extinguish_light.name: Snuffed Light
minecraft:extinguish_light.description: Snuffs a nearby candle, torch or lantern in place.

minecraft:candles_out.name: Candles Out
minecraft:candles_out.description: Every lit candle within range goes out at once.

minecraft:torch_chain.name: Torch Chain
minecraft:torch_chain.description: Up to eight torches go dark one after another, the nearest to the player last.

minecraft:torches_behind.name: Torches Behind
minecraft:torches_behind.description: Underground, the torches behind the player go out one by one, the farthest first. They come back after two minutes.

minecraft:lantern_flicker.name: Lantern Flicker
minecraft:lantern_flicker.description: A lantern flickers off and on three times without leaving its mount.

minecraft:lamp_off.name: Lamp Off
minecraft:lamp_off.description: A lit redstone lamp switches off for a second, then comes back if still powered.

minecraft:campfire_out.name: Campfire Out
minecraft:campfire_out.description: A lit campfire is snuffed out.

minecraft:furnace_dies.name: Dying Furnace
minecraft:furnace_dies.description: A burning furnace goes cold and its fuel is taken out for five seconds, then returned.

minecraft:dimming.name: Dimming
minecraft:dimming.description: The light slowly drains out of the world and then returns. Nothing in the world changes; only the player sees it.

minecraft:blinking.name: Blinking
minecraft:blinking.description: The view goes dark and back several times in quick succession, like heavy eyelids. Only the player sees it.

minecraft:candles_light.name: Candle Lights Itself
minecraft:candles_light.description: An unlit candle nearby lights on its own.

minecraft:new_face.name: New Face
minecraft:new_face.description: A jack o'lantern slowly turns to face another way.

minecraft:blackout.name: Blackout
minecraft:blackout.description: Lights nearby go out and break, and a moment later a zombie or skeleton appears close by and attacks.

minecraft:burning_hand.name: Burning Hand
minecraft:burning_hand.description: The torch or lantern held in the main hand is dropped as if it burned.

minecraft:door.name: Door
minecraft:door.description: A wooden door opens by itself, or an open one slams shut.

minecraft:trapdoor.name: Trapdoor
minecraft:trapdoor.description: A wooden trapdoor flips with a slam.

minecraft:fence_gate.name: Fence Gate
minecraft:fence_gate.description: A fence gate swings open or shut.

minecraft:pressure_plate.name: Pressure Plate
minecraft:pressure_plate.description: A pressure plate triggers for a second with nothing on it.

minecraft:iron_door.name: Iron Door
minecraft:iron_door.description: An iron door opens or shuts without any redstone.

minecraft:breathing_door.name: Breathing Door
minecraft:breathing_door.description: A door opens and closes once a second, six times, and ends as it began.

minecraft:chest_lid.name: Chest Lid
minecraft:chest_lid.description: A chest lid opens and closes with its sound; the contents stay untouched.

minecraft:barrel_opens.name: Barrel Opens
minecraft:barrel_opens.description: A closed barrel opens for a moment, then shuts again.

minecraft:jukebox_pop.name: Jukebox Pop
minecraft:jukebox_pop.description: A playing jukebox cuts its music and spits the disc out.

minecraft:locked_door.name: Locked Door
minecraft:locked_door.description: A door slams shut with a thud and cannot be opened for ten seconds.

minecraft:open_house.name: Open House
minecraft:open_house.description: At night, every closed wooden door nearby swings open.

minecraft:echo.name: Echo
minecraft:echo.description: The last sound the player made, such as a step, a splash or a bite, is played again three seconds later from the place it was made.

minecraft:footsteps.name: Footsteps
minecraft:footsteps.description: A step sounds two blocks behind the player.

minecraft:creeper_hiss.name: Creeper Hiss
minecraft:creeper_hiss.description: A creeper fuse hisses close by, with no creeper in sight.

minecraft:three_knocks.name: Three Knocks
minecraft:three_knocks.description: Three knocks on the nearest wooden door, or from nowhere if there is none.

minecraft:crying_child.name: Crying Child
minecraft:crying_child.description: A high-pitched villager cry somewhere nearby.

minecraft:block_breaking.name: Block Breaking
minecraft:block_breaking.description: Stone, wood, glass or gravel breaks nearby, but nothing is broken.

minecraft:enderman_hiss.name: Enderman Hiss
minecraft:enderman_hiss.description: The sound of an enderman being stared at.

minecraft:chest_opens.name: Chest Opens
minecraft:chest_opens.description: A chest opens somewhere close by.

minecraft:breathing.name: Breathing
minecraft:breathing.description: Five breaths one block from the player, each louder than the last.

minecraft:distant_bell.name: Distant Bell
minecraft:distant_bell.description: A loud bell rings from about forty blocks away.

minecraft:phantom_jukebox.name: Phantom Jukebox
minecraft:phantom_jukebox.description: Music disc 11 plays from a spot nearby, with no jukebox there.

minecraft:music_cut.name: Music Cut
minecraft:music_cut.description: The background music stops and resumes on its usual schedule.

minecraft:whisper.name: Whisper
minecraft:whisper.description: A chat line from "???" with the player's own name, visible only to them.

minecraft:blindness.name: Blindness
minecraft:blindness.description: Blindness for six seconds, with a low cave sound.

minecraft:sanity_crash.name: Shattered Sanity
minecraft:sanity_crash.description: Takes 90 percentage points of sanity, plus the usual event shock. Never goes below zero; creative and spectator players are unaffected.

minecraft:sanity_drain.name: Slipping Sanity
minecraft:sanity_drain.description: Takes a random 10–25 percentage points of sanity, plus the usual event shock. Never goes below zero; creative and spectator players are unaffected.

minecraft:fatigue.name: Fatigue
minecraft:fatigue.description: Mining fatigue II for ten seconds.

minecraft:hunger_pang.name: Hunger Pang
minecraft:hunger_pang.description: Takes three food points, if the player has more than three bars.

minecraft:poison.name: Poison
minecraft:poison.description: Poison for five seconds; it cannot kill.

minecraft:levitation.name: Levitation
minecraft:levitation.description: Levitation for two seconds, then the fall.

minecraft:frostbite.name: Frostbite
minecraft:frostbite.description: The player freezes as in powder snow for about three seconds.

minecraft:cold_touch.name: Cold Touch
minecraft:cold_touch.description: One or two hearts of magic damage with a freezing sound; never lethal.

minecraft:trip.name: Trip
minecraft:trip.description: The player stops dead for a second.

minecraft:scorch.name: Scorch
minecraft:scorch.description: The player is set on fire for a second.

minecraft:wrath.name: Wrath
minecraft:wrath.description: Two to three and a half hearts of magic damage; never lethal.

minecraft:snatch.name: Snatch
minecraft:snatch.description: The item in the main hand is thrown about five blocks away.

minecraft:suffocation.name: Suffocation
minecraft:suffocation.description: A heartbeat, then the air bar drains and the player takes damage. Stops in light, in water, at three hearts or after fifteen seconds.

minecraft:shove.name: Shove
minecraft:shove.description: At the edge of a drop, the player is pushed toward it.

minecraft:toss.name: Toss
minecraft:toss.description: The player is thrown about five blocks straight up.

minecraft:thunder_knocks.name: Thunder Knocks
minecraft:thunder_knocks.description: Three knocks, then a bolt strikes nearby; a second hits the player if they have barely moved.

minecraft:shadow.name: Shadow
minecraft:shadow.description: A dark figure appears far off. It stands still while the player looks at it and walks closer when the player looks away. A touch hurts, down to three hearts at worst. It leaves after a minute.

minecraft:double.name: Double
minecraft:double.description: A figure with the player's own skin and gear appears and runs at them, hitting hard. It cannot be hurt, never takes the player below three hearts, and leaves after half a minute or four hits.

minecraft:edge_figure.name: Edge Figure
minecraft:edge_figure.description: A figure that looks like the player stands at the edge of their vision. It is gone as soon as the player looks straight at it.

minecraft:fog_silhouette.name: Fog Silhouette
minecraft:fog_silhouette.description: In rain or at night under open sky, a pale figure stands far away in the fog. It vanishes when the player comes close.

minecraft:distant_player.name: Distant Player
minecraft:distant_player.description: Another player in a default skin stands far away and keeps looking at the player. It vanishes when the player comes close.

minecraft:distant_walker.name: Distant Walker
minecraft:distant_walker.description: Another player in a default skin walks or runs past far away, across the player's view, jumping up steps and going round what is in its way. It vanishes when the player comes close, when there is no way on, or after a while.

minecraft:nametag.name: Nametag
minecraft:nametag.description: A player's nameplate floats with nobody under it: a few blocks under the floor, seen through it, or far off. Gone after a while.

minecraft:pillar.name: Pillar
minecraft:pillar.description: Another player in a default skin pillars up some way off on cobblestone, stone, dirt or planks: eyes on its feet, a jump, a block under it, a swing of the arm. Gone at the top or when approached; the pillar goes later.

minecraft:harvest.name: Harvest
minecraft:harvest.description: Another player in a default skin stands at the edge of the player's field and harvests the ripe crops within reach, with nothing dropped. They grow back later.

minecraft:armor_stand.name: Armor Stand
minecraft:armor_stand.description: An armor stand turns up a few blocks behind the player. While they look away it follows them and strikes a new pose: arms reaching out, arms raised, a lolling head, a lunge. Breaking it drops nothing. It is gone after two minutes; under hardcore it stays.

minecraft:friend_double.name: Friend's Double
minecraft:friend_double.description: Another player standing near the player is also seen far away, with their skin and name, looking at the player. It vanishes when the player comes close, or after a minute.

minecraft:the_call.name: The Call
minecraft:the_call.description: At night, a voice draws the player along the ground toward nearby lava or a drop into the void, a little at a time. Walking away breaks it. It never takes the player below three hearts by itself.

minecraft:undertow.name: Undertow
minecraft:undertow.description: While the player swims, something pulls them down every tenth of a second. It ends when they leave the water, at 3 hearts, or after 10 s.

minecraft:water_call.name: Water Call
minecraft:water_call.description: The player on land is drawn along the ground toward the nearest water within 12 blocks.

minecraft:drowned_fish.name: Drowned Fish
minecraft:drowned_fish.description: Squid and fish near the player die, in a puff of ink.

minecraft:broken_boat.name: Broken Boat
minecraft:broken_boat.description: An empty boat nearby comes apart.

minecraft:embrace.name: Embrace
minecraft:embrace.description: Growing damage every second until the player is ten blocks from where it began. Stops at three hearts.

minecraft:hotbar_shift.name: Hotbar Shift
minecraft:hotbar_shift.description: The selected hotbar slot changes on its own.

minecraft:book_page.name: Extra Page
minecraft:book_page.description: One creepy page is added to a book and quill or a written book; nothing is erased.

minecraft:shuffle_chest.name: Shuffled Chest
minecraft:shuffle_chest.description: The contents of a nearby chest are shuffled.

minecraft:wear.name: Wear
minecraft:wear.description: A tool loses ten percent durability; it never breaks.

minecraft:rot.name: Rot
minecraft:rot.description: A stack of food in the inventory turns into rotten flesh.

minecraft:tool_look.name: Tool Look
minecraft:tool_look.description: A tool in the inventory looks like another one for a while.

minecraft:armor_off.name: Armor Off
minecraft:armor_off.description: One to four pieces of worn armor come off by themselves and land in the inventory, or on the floor if it is full.

minecraft:vanishing_item.name: Vanishing Item
minecraft:vanishing_item.description: A stack moves from one nearby chest to another.

minecraft:map_marker.name: Map Marker
minecraft:map_marker.description: A red X appears on a filled map and stays there for good.

minecraft:false_compass.name: False Compass
minecraft:false_compass.description: A plain compass points at a spot 30 to 60 blocks away, and keeps doing so.

minecraft:wilted_flowers.name: Wilted Flowers
minecraft:wilted_flowers.description: Potted flowers nearby turn into dead bushes, and are restored after two minutes.

minecraft:withering_crops.name: Withering Crops
minecraft:withering_crops.description: Every grown crop nearby loses one growth stage.

minecraft:turning_frame.name: Turning Frame
minecraft:turning_frame.description: The item in an item frame rotates.

minecraft:new_sign.name: New Sign
minecraft:new_sign.description: A sign's front text becomes a creepy phrase; restored after a minute unless the player edited it.

minecraft:new_painting.name: New Painting
minecraft:new_painting.description: A painting becomes another one of the same size; restored after a minute.

minecraft:glass_wall.name: Glass Wall
minecraft:glass_wall.description: A wall in front of the player turns to glass for four seconds, with a motionless husk standing behind it.

minecraft:dry_cauldron.name: Dry Cauldron
minecraft:dry_cauldron.description: A water cauldron nearby is emptied.

minecraft:dead_ground.name: Dead Ground
minecraft:dead_ground.description: A ragged patch of grass under the player turns to dirt.

minecraft:shifting_floor.name: Shifting Floor
minecraft:shifting_floor.description: The floor under the player briefly turns into another kind of the same material.

minecraft:repaint.name: Repaint
minecraft:repaint.description: Blocks of one kind nearby take on a neighbouring colour, or turn into stripped wood or stone, and change back after a minute.

minecraft:broken_bed.name: Broken Bed
minecraft:broken_bed.description: A nearby bed breaks and drops as an item.

minecraft:wall_hole.name: Wall Hole
minecraft:wall_hole.description: Two blocks of a thin wall vanish for thirty seconds, with no drops.

minecraft:cross.name: Cross
minecraft:cross.description: A plus of bone blocks stands on the ground for a minute.

minecraft:cat_hiss.name: Cat Hiss
minecraft:cat_hiss.description: A nearby cat hisses at nothing.

minecraft:cat_flee.name: Cats Flee
minecraft:cat_flee.description: Cats nearby run away from where the spirit is.

minecraft:dream.name: Dream
minecraft:dream.description: The next time the player wakes, they remember a dream about a spirit near them.

minecraft:dog_barks.name: Dog Barks
minecraft:dog_barks.description: A wolf turns away and barks at nothing.

minecraft:animals_stare.name: Animals Stare
minecraft:animals_stare.description: Animals nearby stop and stare at the player for three seconds.

minecraft:pen_corner.name: Corner of the Pen
minecraft:pen_corner.description: The animals in a fenced pen crowd into one corner and stand facing it for fifteen seconds.

minecraft:villager_stares.name: Villager Stares
minecraft:villager_stares.description: A villager stops and stares at the player for five seconds.

minecraft:villager_refuses.name: Villager Refuses
minecraft:villager_refuses.description: A villager shakes its head and says no to nobody.

minecraft:bats.name: Bats
minecraft:bats.description: Five bats appear close to the player.

minecraft:open_pen.name: Open Pen
minecraft:open_pen.description: A closed gate beside animals swings open.

minecraft:wild_pet.name: Wild Pet
minecraft:wild_pet.description: A tamed pet loses its owner and turns on the player.

minecraft:copycat.name: Copycat
minecraft:copycat.description: A zombie wearing a copy of the player's armor appears behind them and attacks.

minecraft:cold_breath.name: Cold Breath
minecraft:cold_breath.description: A puff of breath at the player's face, as if in the cold.

minecraft:footprints.name: Footprints
minecraft:footprints.description: On sand or snow, puffs and step sounds appear where the player stood a second ago.

minecraft:local_rain.name: Local Rain
minecraft:local_rain.description: Rain falls over the player alone for six seconds.

minecraft:lost_time.name: Lost Time
minecraft:lost_time.description: At night, the clock jumps a thousand ticks forward for everyone.

minecraft:distant_mob.name: Distant Mob
minecraft:distant_mob.description: A monster sound or a ghostly moan from anywhere between two and forty blocks away.

minecraft:hostile_animal.name: Hostile Animal
minecraft:hostile_animal.description: A nearby animal groans like a zombie or hisses like a creeper; only the player hears it.

minecraft:approaching_steps.name: Approaching Steps
minecraft:approaching_steps.description: Footsteps close in from some bearing, from far off to near the player.

minecraft:distant_mining.name: Distant Mining
minecraft:distant_mining.description: Under the open sky, rhythmic stone hits and a break sound from below ground.

minecraft:many_breaks.name: Many Breaks
minecraft:many_breaks.description: Six or more glass or stone blocks nearby break one after another. Under hardcore they are gone, with no drops.

minecraft:ladder_steps.name: Ladder Steps
minecraft:ladder_steps.description: Someone climbs a real ladder nearby, or something rises where there is none.

minecraft:spider_overhead.name: Spider Overhead
minecraft:spider_overhead.description: Under a low ceiling, a spider crawls across it right above the player.

minecraft:cracking_floor.name: Cracking Floor
minecraft:cracking_floor.description: The block under the player sounds and looks as if it breaks, and holds.

minecraft:bottle_shatter.name: Bottle Shatter
minecraft:bottle_shatter.description: A splash potion shatters nearby, with no potion.

minecraft:note_block_voice.name: Note Block Voice
minecraft:note_block_voice.description: A note block nearby plays a voice instead of a note.

minecraft:ghost_laugh.name: Ghost Laugh
minecraft:ghost_laugh.description: A ghostly laugh from a few blocks away.

minecraft:ghost_breath.name: Ghost Breath
minecraft:ghost_breath.description: A cold breath right behind the player's neck.

minecraft:close_whispers.name: Close Whispers
minecraft:close_whispers.description: Three whispers at the player's ears, one side after the other.

minecraft:circling_moan.name: Circling Moan
minecraft:circling_moan.description: A moan that comes round the player, a new bearing each time.

minecraft:cut_off_scream.name: Cut-Off Scream
minecraft:cut_off_scream.description: A scream nearby that stops dead after less than a second.

minecraft:banshee.name: Banshee
minecraft:banshee.description: A long shriek from far off and high up.

minecraft:lost_growth.name: Lost Growth
minecraft:lost_growth.description: One crop, stem, berry bush or cocoa pod nearby is back to a seedling.

minecraft:false_windows.name: False Windows
minecraft:false_windows.description: Every window nearby is gone, or fenced, or walled up with what is around it, for this player alone. A click on one, or coming back later, shows the glass.

minecraft:false_looks.name: False Looks
minecraft:false_looks.description: Blocks nearby that one uses look like others of the kind for this player alone: a crafting table like a furnace, a stonecutter like a loom, a chest like an anvil. A click on one shows what it is.

minecraft:ghost_tree.name: Ghost Tree
minecraft:ghost_tree.description: A tree, pale oak, oak or birch, stands where there was none, for this player alone, and they can walk straight through it. Gone after a minute.

minecraft:torch_line.name: Torch Line
minecraft:torch_line.description: A line of torches in the dark leads away from this player, and only they see it. Each one is gone when they come near it, and the rest after a minute.

minecraft:hallucination.name: Hallucination
minecraft:hallucination.description: A mob stands out in the field facing the player, an iron golem or a villager, that is not there: nothing can touch it. Gone when approached.

minecraft:disguise.name: Disguise
minecraft:disguise.description: An animal nearby looks like another kind to this player alone: a cow like a sheep, a chicken like a wolf.

minecraft:dragon_flyover.name: Dragon Flyover
minecraft:dragon_flyover.description: With a growl, the ender dragon flies over high up, for this player alone.

minecraft:moving_tree.name: Moving Tree
minecraft:moving_tree.description: A tree nearby shifts a few blocks to the side, trunk and crown together, and a half-minute later is back.

minecraft:false_wound.name: False Wound
minecraft:false_wound.description: For a moment the health bar shows four hearts less; the real health is untouched.

minecraft:false_hearts.name: False Hearts
minecraft:false_hearts.description: Wither or poison hearts for five seconds, with no effect.

minecraft:false_hunger.name: False Hunger
minecraft:false_hunger.description: For a moment the hunger bar shows empty.

minecraft:guardian_face.name: Guardian Face
minecraft:guardian_face.description: The elder guardian's face, far from any monument.

minecraft:false_totem.name: False Totem
minecraft:false_totem.description: The totem of undying animation, with no totem.

minecraft:subliminal_title.name: Subliminal Title
minecraft:subliminal_title.description: A title like "BEHIND YOU" for three ticks.

minecraft:red_vignette.name: Red Vignette
minecraft:red_vignette.description: The screen's edges go red, as at the world border, for five seconds.

minecraft:own_voice.name: Own Voice
minecraft:own_voice.description: A chat line in the player's own name that they never wrote, seen only by them.

minecraft:false_death.name: False Death
minecraft:false_death.description: The player's own death message, "slain by ???", seen only by them.

minecraft:private_rain.name: Private Rain
minecraft:private_rain.description: Rain, sometimes a storm, that only this player sees, for twenty seconds.

minecraft:silent_lightning.name: Silent Lightning
minecraft:silent_lightning.description: Lightning strikes nearby and sets nothing on fire.

minecraft:false_night.name: False Night
minecraft:false_night.description: Night falls in the middle of the day, for this player alone, and the sky stops. The real time comes back a moment later.

minecraft:false_slot.name: False Slot
minecraft:false_slot.description: An empty inventory slot shows an item that is not there: a skull, a bone, the player's own head. Any click shows the truth.

minecraft:false_advancement.name: False Advancement
minecraft:false_advancement.description: An advancement toast: "Who are you?", "Not Alone", "Behind You". It is gone from the advancements as soon as it is shown.

minecraft:turned_head.name: Turned Head
minecraft:turned_head.description: A step sounds where the spirit is, and the player's head turns toward it, slowly, by itself.

minecraft:stranger_joins.name: Someone Joins
minecraft:stranger_joins.description: Someone joins the game: the yellow chat line and a name in the player list, which then opens even in single player. They leave a while later.

minecraft:false_whisper.name: False Whisper
minecraft:false_whisper.description: A private message in /msg style from a real online player who never sent it. Off by default.

minecraft:stranger_death.name: Someone Dies
minecraft:stranger_death.description: A death message about another player in chat, in the player's language.

minecraft:lectern_pages.name: Lectern Pages
minecraft:lectern_pages.description: A book on a lectern turns to another page by itself.

minecraft:pot_wobble.name: Pot Wobble
minecraft:pot_wobble.description: A decorated pot wobbles as if something were pushed into it.

minecraft:bell_swing.name: Bell Swing
minecraft:bell_swing.description: A bell swings and rings with nobody near it.

minecraft:redstone_drift.name: Redstone Drift
minecraft:redstone_drift.description: A repeater gets another delay or a comparator the other mode, silently, until it is set back.

minecraft:occupied_bed.name: Occupied Bed
minecraft:occupied_bed.description: A bed reads as occupied for a while, with nobody in it.

minecraft:shuffled_books.name: Shuffled Books
minecraft:shuffled_books.description: The books on a chiseled bookshelf take other slots, until they are put back.

minecraft:dispenser_shot.name: Dispenser Shot
minecraft:dispenser_shot.description: A dispenser clicks, then shoots an arrow at the player.

minecraft:golem_rage.name: Golem Rage
minecraft:golem_rage.description: The nearest idle iron golem within 24 blocks turns on the player. Player-built golems remain friendly; anger follows vanilla rules.

minecraft:golem_flower.name: Golem Flower
minecraft:golem_flower.description: An iron golem holds out a poppy to empty air.

minecraft:wolf_rage.name: Wolf Rage
minecraft:wolf_rage.description: Idle wild wolves within 16 blocks turn on the player with vanilla persistent anger. Tamed wolves remain friendly.

minecraft:dog_growls.name: Dog Growls
minecraft:dog_growls.description: A tamed dog sits, stares at the empty space beside the player and growls.

minecraft:angry_bees.name: Angry Bees
minecraft:angry_bees.description: The bees of a nearby hive pour out angry at the player.

minecraft:leash_snaps.name: Leash Snaps
minecraft:leash_snaps.description: A leash on a fence post comes loose and the animal runs free.

minecraft:enderman_takes.name: Enderman Takes
minecraft:enderman_takes.description: An enderman nearby picks up a block from the player's build.

minecraft:torch_swap.name: Torch Swap
minecraft:torch_swap.description: A torch or lantern nearby turns into another kind.

minecraft:goat_rams.name: Goat Rams
minecraft:goat_rams.description: A goat nearby charges at the player's position.

minecraft:boat_drifts.name: Boat Drifts
minecraft:boat_drifts.description: An empty boat in the water slides slowly away from the player.

minecraft:minecart_rolls.name: Minecart Rolls
minecraft:minecart_rolls.description: An empty minecart on a rail rolls toward the player.

minecraft:shrieker.name: Shrieker
minecraft:shrieker.description: A sculk shrieker shrieks with nothing near it; nobody is warned.

minecraft:fake_subtitle.name: Fake Subtitle
minecraft:fake_subtitle.description: A silent sound that shows the subtitle "Something breathes behind you", from behind the player. Only seen with subtitles on.

minecraft:phantom_heartbeat.name: Phantom Heartbeat
minecraft:phantom_heartbeat.description: A warden heartbeat with no warden.

minecraft:insomnia.name: Insomnia
minecraft:insomnia.description: The player is counted as three days without sleep, so phantoms come the next night.

minecraft:infested.name: Infested
minecraft:infested.description: Infested for thirty seconds: silverfish crawl out when the player is hurt.

minecraft:oozing.name: Oozing
minecraft:oozing.description: Oozing for thirty seconds: slimes spill out if the player dies.

minecraft:weaving.name: Weaving
minecraft:weaving.description: Weaving for thirty seconds: cobwebs form if the player dies.

minecraft:drift.name: Drift
minecraft:drift.description: A slow pull in one direction for three seconds, as if by a current.

minecraft:sleepwalk.name: Sleepwalking
minecraft:sleepwalk.description: After the player next sleeps, they wake up on safe ground some way from the bed.

minecraft:infested_stone.name: Infested Stone
minecraft:infested_stone.description: The stone the player looks at is shown as its infested kind for thirty seconds.

minecraft:ceiling_crack.name: Ceiling Crack
minecraft:ceiling_crack.description: A block overhead cracks as if someone were mining it from above, silently.

minecraft:ice_over.name: Ice Over
minecraft:ice_over.description: Up to 24 source water blocks nearby freeze for thirty seconds.

minecraft:chest_blast.name: Chest Blast
minecraft:chest_blast.description: The chest the player opened hisses, then blasts; no blocks break.

minecraft:wrong_smelt.name: Wrong Smelt
minecraft:wrong_smelt.description: The output of a furnace turns into charcoal or rotten flesh, and comes back after two minutes unless taken.

minecraft:furniture_moves.name: Moved Furniture
minecraft:furniture_moves.description: A chest, crafting table, furnace or bed nearby now stands a few blocks away, contents and all; it is moved back after five minutes if both spots are untouched.

minecraft:doorstep_gift.name: Doorstep Gift
minecraft:doorstep_gift.description: A flower, a bone or raw rabbit lies outside a nearby door.

minecraft:muddy_footprints.name: Muddy Footprints
minecraft:muddy_footprints.description: Muddy footprints cross the room to a bed or a chest, until they are gone.

minecraft:portal_out.name: Portal Out
minecraft:portal_out.description: The nether portal nearby breaks, every block of it, with a fizzle; the frame is left standing. In the Nether it comes back after a minute.

minecraft:block_blink.name: Block Blink
minecraft:block_blink.description: The block the player looks at breaks with its sound and dust, and is back two seconds later.

minecraft:leak.name: Leak
minecraft:leak.description: Water drips from the ceiling overhead for a few seconds; only seen and heard.

minecraft:lava_leak.name: Lava Leak
minecraft:lava_leak.description: Lava drips from the ceiling overhead for a few seconds; only seen and heard.

minecraft:mock_grave.name: Mock Grave
minecraft:mock_grave.description: A gravestone with a sign appears on open ground nearby, bearing the player's name and tomorrow's date.

minecraft:cave_sign.name: Cave Sign
minecraft:cave_sign.description: A sign appears on a wall of the tunnel nearby with a short warning or beckoning; it is taken down after a few minutes.

minecraft:item_trail.name: Item Trail
minecraft:item_trail.description: A trail of bones, flesh and string that cannot be picked up leads to a sign with a short note; both are cleared after a few minutes.

minecraft:walled_in.name: Walled In
minecraft:walled_in.description: Knocking on every side, then walls of the surrounding stone close around the player and over their head, with mining fatigue; they crumble after twenty seconds.

minecraft:sealed_tunnel.name: Sealed Tunnel
minecraft:sealed_tunnel.description: The tunnel a few blocks behind the player is filled in, wall to wall, with the stone around it; it opens again after a minute.

minecraft:lights_out.name: Lights Out, One by One
minecraft:lights_out.description: Scenario: a lantern flickers, the torches go out one by one, something breathes beside the player, then the dark fills with monsters.

minecraft:playing_with_candles.name: Playing with Candles
minecraft:playing_with_candles.description: Scenario: the candles go out, light again, go out once more, and something laughs.

minecraft:hearth_dies.name: The Hearth Dies
minecraft:hearth_dies.description: Scenario: the furnace and the campfire die together, a cold breath follows, then frost bites.

minecraft:lamp_code.name: Lamp Code
minecraft:lamp_code.description: Scenario: a redstone lamp goes out three times, three knocks answer, then a lever flips.

minecraft:gone_in_the_fog.name: Gone in the Fog
minecraft:gone_in_the_fog.description: Scenario: a pale stranger stands in the fog; once it is gone, steps follow and a breath comes from behind.

minecraft:walking_in_sleep.name: Walking in Sleep
minecraft:walking_in_sleep.description: Scenario: whispers close in, then the player is made to sleepwalk; on waking, muddy footprints and a sign in a cave are found.

minecraft:bad_dream.name: Bad Dream
minecraft:bad_dream.description: Scenario: a dream waits for sleep; on waking the night turns false and whispers close in.

minecraft:taken_under.name: Taken Under
minecraft:taken_under.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: whispers, a pull toward the water, and once in it the undertow drags the player down while the fish die.

minecraft:the_debt.name: The Debt
minecraft:the_debt.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: the screen reddens, the lights die, wrath strikes, then a voice draws the player toward lava or the void.

minecraft:behind_you.name: Behind You
minecraft:behind_you.description: Scenario: underground, the torches behind the player go out one by one, steps follow, a cold breath touches the neck, then the player's head turns by itself.

minecraft:between_blinks.name: Between Blinks
minecraft:between_blinks.description: Scenario: the light slowly drains out of the world, the view blinks dark several times, and a figure stands at the edge of vision.

minecraft:soul_fire.name: Soul Fire
minecraft:soul_fire.description: Scenario: a torch or lantern turns into another kind, a lantern flickers three times, "BEHIND YOU" flashes for an instant, then sanity drains.

minecraft:pocket_dark.name: Pocket Dark
minecraft:pocket_dark.description: Scenario: the torch or lantern in the player's hand goes out, darkness falls, whispers come close at both ears, then a cold touch hurts.

minecraft:the_path_of_lights.name: The Path of Lights
minecraft:the_path_of_lights.description: Scenario: a line of torches leads away through the dark, the music cuts out, then a pale silhouette appears in the fog.

minecraft:jack_o_lanterns.name: Jack o'Lanterns
minecraft:jack_o_lanterns.description: Scenario: three jack o'lanterns slowly turn to face another way, then a stranger walks past in the distance.

minecraft:knock_knock.name: Knock, Knock
minecraft:knock_knock.description: Scenario: three knocks on the nearest door, the door opens or slams by itself, footsteps close in, then something breathes right beside the player.

minecraft:unlocked_house.name: Open House
minecraft:unlocked_house.description: Scenario: a door opens and closes as if breathing, every closed wooden door nearby swings open at night, then a monster sounds far off.

minecraft:locked_in.name: Locked In
minecraft:locked_in.description: Scenario: three knocks sound, a door slams and will not open, something breathes close by, the candles go out, then a cold touch lands.

minecraft:rearranged.name: Rearranged
minecraft:rearranged.description: Scenario: a decorated pot wobbles, the books on a shelf change places, a painting turns into another, furniture moves, and something laughs.

minecraft:midnight_kitchen.name: Midnight Kitchen
minecraft:midnight_kitchen.description: Scenario: a chest lid opens and shuts, someone eats behind the wall, the furnace output turns to charcoal or rotten flesh, then a hunger pang strikes.

minecraft:a_visitor.name: A Visitor
minecraft:a_visitor.description: Scenario: a gift appears outside the door, muddy footprints cross the room, three knocks sound, then a door opens or slams by itself.

minecraft:trap_room.name: Trap Room
minecraft:trap_room.description: Scenario: a pressure plate triggers with nobody on it, a dispenser shoots an arrow at the player, and a ghostly laugh follows.

minecraft:ticking_chest.name: Ticking Chest
minecraft:ticking_chest.description: Scenario: a chest opens nearby, a lid opens and closes by itself, then the chest the player opened hisses and blasts without breaking blocks.

minecraft:nothing_works.name: Nothing Works
minecraft:nothing_works.description: Scenario: a lever flips, a button presses itself, an iron door moves without redstone, a repeater drifts, and a jukebox spits out its disc.

minecraft:last_song.name: Last Song
minecraft:last_song.description: Scenario: music disc 11 plays where there is no jukebox, a real jukebox cuts its music and spits out the disc, then a child cries nearby.

minecraft:company.name: Company
minecraft:company.description: Scenario: a stranger joins the game, a lone player stands far off watching, then builds a pillar, and finally a chat message reports the stranger's death.

minecraft:someone_at_my_crops.name: Someone at My Crops
minecraft:someone_at_my_crops.description: Scenario: someone joins the game, a stranger harvests the ripe crops at the edge of the field, and one plant is back to a seedling.

minecraft:closing_in.name: Closing In
minecraft:closing_in.description: Scenario: a distant stranger walks past, footsteps close in on the player, then a figure appears at the edge of their vision.

minecraft:a_name_below.name: A Name Below
minecraft:a_name_below.description: Scenario: a nameplate floats below the floor with nobody under it, someone joins the game, then "???" whispers the player's name in chat.

minecraft:the_other_builder.name: The Other Builder
minecraft:the_other_builder.description: Scenario: a distant player pillars up, blocks nearby break one after another, then a sign with a warning appears on a tunnel wall.

minecraft:died_out_there.name: Died Out There
minecraft:died_out_there.description: Scenario: a stranger walks by far away, a scream is cut off, chat reports another player's death, then a gravestone with the player's name appears.

minecraft:the_dead_party.name: The Dead Party
minecraft:the_dead_party.description: Scenario: three strangers join the game, one stands far away watching, a pale figure shows in the fog, then death messages for the strangers follow.

minecraft:friend_far_off.name: Friend Far Off
minecraft:friend_far_off.description: Scenario: a nearby player is also seen far away, watching, then "???" whispers in chat and a subtitle says something breathes behind the player.

minecraft:statue_game.name: Statue Game
minecraft:statue_game.description: Scenario: an armor stand appears behind the player and creeps closer whenever they look away, steps sound, and the player's head turns toward the spirit.

minecraft:your_armor_fits_it.name: Your Armor Fits It
minecraft:your_armor_fits_it.description: Scenario: a cold breath touches the player's neck, worn armor comes off, something laughs, then a zombie in a copy of the armor attacks from behind.

minecraft:who_said_that.name: Who Said That
minecraft:who_said_that.description: Scenario: a chat line appears in the player's own name, their last sound echoes back, another line follows, then a title flashes for an instant.

minecraft:your_grave.name: Your Grave
minecraft:your_grave.description: Scenario: a gravestone with the player's name appears nearby, a figure stands at the edge of vision, then a death message reads "slain by ???".

minecraft:behind_the_glass.name: Behind the Glass
minecraft:behind_the_glass.description: Scenario: the windows nearby vanish for this player alone, a wall turns to glass with a husk standing behind it, then a figure like the player lurks at the edge of sight.

minecraft:same_steps.name: Same Steps
minecraft:same_steps.description: Scenario: footprints appear where the player just stood, a subtitle says something breathes behind, then a figure stands at the edge of vision.

minecraft:someone_in_my_bed.name: Someone in My Bed
minecraft:someone_in_my_bed.description: Scenario: something breathes beside the player, a bed reads as occupied, heaviness slows them, then a warden heartbeat sounds with no warden.

minecraft:no_rest.name: No Rest
minecraft:no_rest.description: Scenario: a warden's heartbeat sounds with no warden, the player counts as three days without sleep, a whisper follows, then a bed reads as occupied.

minecraft:shattered_sleep.name: Shattered Sleep
minecraft:shattered_sleep.description: Scenario: a warden heartbeat sounds with no warden, the nearby bed breaks, and a ghostly laugh follows.

minecraft:night_at_noon.name: Night at Noon
minecraft:night_at_noon.description: Scenario: night falls in the middle of the day, a moan circles the player, silent lightning strikes nearby, and a monster sounds in the distance.

minecraft:lost_hour.name: Lost Hour
minecraft:lost_hour.description: Scenario: the view blinks dark, the clock jumps an hour ahead at night, a whisper speaks the player's name, then sanity drains.

minecraft:sleep_paralysis.name: Sleep Paralysis
minecraft:sleep_paralysis.description: Scenario: darkness falls, the player stops dead for a second, a cold breath touches the neck, then a title flashes "BEHIND YOU".

minecraft:the_other_miner.name: The Other Miner
minecraft:the_other_miner.description: Scenario: rhythmic mining sounds from below, blocks nearby break one after another, then a sign with a warning appears in the tunnel.

minecraft:overhead.name: Overhead
minecraft:overhead.description: Scenario: a spider crawls across the ceiling right above the player, a block overhead cracks as if mined, then the floor underfoot cracks and holds.

minecraft:floor_gives_way.name: Floor Gives Way
minecraft:floor_gives_way.description: Scenario: blocks break nearby unharmed, the floor underfoot seems to crack, it shifts into another material, then the player is shoved toward the drop.

minecraft:deep_calling.name: Deep Calling
minecraft:deep_calling.description: Scenario: someone climbs a ladder nearby, a whisper follows, then a voice draws the player toward lava or a drop into the void.

minecraft:nest.name: Nest
minecraft:nest.description: Scenario: stone, wood and gravel break out of sight, the stone the player looks at turns infested, and then the player is infested too.

minecraft:lava_tears.name: Lava Tears
minecraft:lava_tears.description: Scenario: lava drips from the ceiling, the player is set on fire for a second, then the torch in hand is dropped as if it burned.

minecraft:no_way_back.name: No Way Back
minecraft:no_way_back.description: Scenario: the torches behind the player go out one by one, footsteps close in, then the tunnel behind them is sealed with stone.

minecraft:buried_alive.name: Buried Alive
minecraft:buried_alive.description: Scenario: a warning sign appears on the tunnel wall, stone closes around the player on every side, then the air runs out.

minecraft:ancient_city.name: Ancient City
minecraft:ancient_city.description: Scenario: a sculk shrieker shrieks for nothing, a warden heartbeat sounds with no warden, then darkness falls.

minecraft:hole_in_the_wall.name: Hole in the Wall
minecraft:hole_in_the_wall.description: Scenario: the block the player looks at breaks and comes back, two blocks of a thin wall vanish, and a monster sounds in the distance.

minecraft:dead_lake.name: Dead Lake
minecraft:dead_lake.description: Scenario: fish and squid die around the swimmer in puffs of ink, the elder guardian's face appears, then an undertow drags them down.

minecraft:adrift.name: Adrift
minecraft:adrift.description: Scenario: an empty boat slides away from the player, rain falls over the player alone, then a nearby boat comes apart.

minecraft:voice_from_the_water.name: Voice from the Water
minecraft:voice_from_the_water.description: Scenario: water drips nearby, whispers sound at the player's ears, then the player is drawn along the ground toward the nearest water.

minecraft:frozen_pond.name: Frozen Pond
minecraft:frozen_pond.description: Scenario: nearby water freezes over, a cold breath touches the player's face, then frost bites.

minecraft:leaky_roof.name: Leaky Roof
minecraft:leaky_roof.description: Scenario: water drips from the ceiling, drips again nearby, then a water cauldron is emptied.

minecraft:into_the_corner.name: Into the Corner
minecraft:into_the_corner.description: Scenario: animals stop and stare at the player, the animals in a pen crowd into one corner, then a closed gate swings open.

minecraft:the_dog_sees_it.name: The Dog Sees It
minecraft:the_dog_sees_it.description: Scenario: a tamed dog stares at empty space and growls, a step sounds behind the player, then a freezing touch lands.

minecraft:cats_know.name: Cats Know
minecraft:cats_know.description: Scenario: nearby cats run away, one hisses at nothing, then a figure stands at the edge of vision.

minecraft:not_my_dog.name: Not My Dog
minecraft:not_my_dog.description: Scenario: a wolf barks at nothing, a tamed dog growls at empty space beside the player, then a pet turns on its owner.

minecraft:swarm.name: Swarm
minecraft:swarm.description: Scenario: five bats appear close to the player, a spider crawls across the ceiling overhead, then the bees of a nearby hive pour out angry.

minecraft:wrong_herd.name: Wrong Herd
minecraft:wrong_herd.description: Scenario: a nearby animal looks like another kind, the animals stop and stare at the player, then one of them groans or hisses.

minecraft:the_golem_mourns.name: The Golem Mourns
minecraft:the_golem_mourns.description: Scenario: an iron golem holds a poppy out to empty air, a bell tolls from afar, and a villager stares at the player.

minecraft:the_golem_turns.name: The Golem Turns
minecraft:the_golem_turns.description: Scenario: a villager shakes its head at nobody, an iron golem offers a poppy to empty air, then the nearest idle golem turns on the player.

minecraft:stolen_block.name: Stolen Block
minecraft:stolen_block.description: Scenario: an enderman hisses, picks up a block from the player's build, then two blocks of a thin wall vanish.

minecraft:runaway_cart.name: Runaway Cart
minecraft:runaway_cart.description: Scenario: mining sounds echo from below, an empty minecart rolls along the rail toward the player, then the player stops dead for a second.

minecraft:pack.name: Pack
minecraft:pack.description: Scenario: a moan circles the player, then idle wild wolves nearby turn on them in rage.

minecraft:billy_goat.name: Billy Goat
minecraft:billy_goat.description: Scenario: nearby animals stop and stare, a leash snaps and the animal runs free, then a goat charges at the player.

minecraft:you_died.name: You Died
minecraft:you_died.description: Scenario: the health bar shows four hearts less, wither or poison hearts appear, then a death message reads "slain by ???".

minecraft:saved_by_nothing.name: Saved by Nothing
minecraft:saved_by_nothing.description: Scenario: the health bar drops by four hearts without real damage, a totem animation plays with no totem, and a ghostly laugh follows.

minecraft:achievement_get.name: Achievement Get
minecraft:achievement_get.description: Scenario: a false advancement pops up, a title flashes for three ticks, then a chat line appears in the player's own name.

minecraft:starving.name: Starving
minecraft:starving.description: Scenario: the hunger bar flashes empty, someone eats behind the wall, then ravenous hunger sets in.

minecraft:what_s_in_my_pocket.name: What's in My Pocket
minecraft:what_s_in_my_pocket.description: Scenario: an empty slot shows an item that is not there, two inventory slots trade places, then the selected hotbar slot changes on its own.

minecraft:silence.name: Silence
minecraft:silence.description: Scenario: the music cuts out, a subtitle says something breathes behind you, then five breaths sound beside the player, each louder than the last.

minecraft:seeing_red.name: Seeing Red
minecraft:seeing_red.description: Scenario: the screen's edges go red, a warden's heartbeat sounds with no warden, then wrath strikes for magic damage.

minecraft:the_sky_lies.name: The Sky Lies
minecraft:the_sky_lies.description: Scenario: the ender dragon flies high overhead, lightning strikes nearby without fire, then a monster sound comes from afar.

minecraft:mind_slipping.name: Mind Slipping
minecraft:mind_slipping.description: Scenario: the view blinks dark several times, sanity drains, nearby blocks look like others of their kind, then sanity shatters.

minecraft:hoard.name: Hoard
minecraft:hoard.description: Scenario: the contents of a nearby chest are shuffled, a stack moves to another chest, then a chest opens by itself nearby.

minecraft:butterfingers.name: Butterfingers
minecraft:butterfingers.description: Scenario: the selected hotbar slot changes by itself, the item in hand is thrown about five blocks away, and something laughs.

minecraft:x_marks_the_spot.name: X Marks the Spot
minecraft:x_marks_the_spot.description: Scenario: a red X appears on the map, the compass points at a false spot, then a trail of bones leads to a sign with a note.

minecraft:the_journal.name: The Journal
minecraft:the_journal.description: Scenario: a creepy page is added to the player's book, a book on a lectern turns its page by itself, then whispers come close.

minecraft:blight.name: Blight
minecraft:blight.description: Scenario: grass under the player turns to dirt, nearby crops lose a growth stage, then a stack of food in the inventory rots.

minecraft:funeral.name: Funeral
minecraft:funeral.description: Scenario: potted flowers wilt into dead bushes, a cross of bone blocks stands on the ground, then a scream sounds nearby.

minecraft:walking_woods.name: Walking Woods
minecraft:walking_woods.description: Scenario: a ghost tree stands where there was none, a nearby tree shifts aside, then a step sounds right behind the player.

minecraft:tantrum.name: Tantrum
minecraft:tantrum.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: a door breathes, every wooden door swings open, furniture moves away, the held item is thrown off, then the opened chest blasts.

minecraft:supper.name: Supper
minecraft:supper.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: a nearby light is snuffed, someone eats behind a wall, torches go dark in a chain, the eating sounds again, then the lights break and a monster attacks.

minecraft:replacement.name: Replacement
minecraft:replacement.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: footprints appear, the player's own voice speaks in chat, a figure stands at the edge of vision, the death message "slain by ???" shows, then a double attacks.

minecraft:wearing_faces.name: Wearing Faces
minecraft:wearing_faces.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: an animal looks like another kind, it groans or hisses, a phantom mob stares, armor comes off, then a zombie in the player's armor attacks.

minecraft:lights_at_your_back.name: Lights at Your Back
minecraft:lights_at_your_back.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: the torches behind the player go out, the light in hand dies, footsteps close in, then a dark figure appears far off.

minecraft:rider.name: Rider
minecraft:rider.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: a bed reads as occupied, breathing sounds beside the player, slowness sets in, darkness falls, then a growing pressure hurts the player until they get away.

minecraft:foretold.name: Foretold
minecraft:foretold.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: a bell tolls, a banshee shrieks, a scream is cut off, the death message "slain by ???" shows, then a gravestone with the player's name appears.

minecraft:blood_for_blood.name: Blood for Blood
minecraft:blood_for_blood.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: a scream sounds, the screen reddens, a zombie in the player's armor attacks, a pet turns on them, then wrath strikes.

minecraft:the_way_they_went.name: The Way They Went
minecraft:the_way_they_went.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: muddy footprints and a trail of bones lead to a note, a line of torches leads off, a death message appears, then time jumps forward.

minecraft:house_rules.name: House Rules
minecraft:house_rules.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: a door, a trapdoor, a fence gate, a button and a lever all move by themselves, a door slams shut and locks, then the books on a shelf change places.

minecraft:feast.name: Feast
minecraft:feast.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: the hunger bar flashes empty, someone eats behind the wall, food rots, a furnace yields charcoal, then a stack moves between chests.

minecraft:punchline.name: Punchline
minecraft:punchline.description: Scenario of an evolved spirit: a false advancement and a false totem appear, a chest lid opens, the chest hisses and blasts, then a ghostly laugh rings out.
